title: Anal Sex
summary: Anal sex involves stimulation or penetration of the anus. The anus doesn't self-lubricate and its tissue is delicate, so lube, going slowly and condoms are important; STI risk is higher than for many other activities.
do: Go slowly and stop if it hurts
dont: Go from anal to vaginal contact without changing the condom or washing
